decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (1 Tiverton Road - Revision 1, sheets 3, 4 and 5, received 6 August 2017 ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall be used for storage purposes and shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes incidental to the residential use of the dwellings at 1 Tiverton Road TW3 4JE, nor shall any bathroom or kitchen facilities be installed into the outbuilding, nor shall it be used for any business purposes without a separate grant of planning permission by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - No door or access which opens onto the pedestrian footway shall be formed in the south eastern elevation of the outbuilding hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a detached single storey outbuilding to the rear.
